description: This is a Dart source file for a Flutter application, defining the main game page for a Tic Tac Toe game. It includes the GamePage widget, its state management, game logic, and UI components such as the game board, status bar, and result banner.

classes.name: GamePage
classes.description: A StatefulWidget representing the main game screen for Tic Tac Toe.

classes.name: _GamePageState
classes.description: State class managing the game logic, state, and UI rendering for GamePage.

methods.name: initState
methods.description: Initializes the game state when the widget is first created, calling _reset to start with a fresh game.

methods.name: _reset
methods.description: Resets the game board, current player, game result, and winning line, updating the state accordingly.

methods.name: _handleCellTap
methods.description: Handles user taps on cells, updating the game state, checking for a winner or draw, and switching players.

methods.name: _findWinningLine
methods.description: Determines if there's a winning line on the board, returning the indices of the winning cells.

methods.name: _resultText
methods.description: Returns the display text corresponding to the current game result.
